name: My Food Bag Group Limited
sector: Consumer Staples / Meal Kits & Online Grocery
quirks: FY ends 31 March; NZX half-yearly reporting (H1 = six months to 30 September).
Presentation PDFs were historically misnamed off by one FY; trust the period stated inside the document, not the filename.
FY2022 EBITDA NZ$34.2m is a genuine COVID lockdown peak (~2.1x current run-rate) - exclude FY2021-22 from growth and exit-multiple anchoring.
No goodwill impairments in FY2021-26 (goodwill flat at NZ$63.6m); NPAT decline was margin compression, not write-downs.
FreeCashFlow is lease-adjusted owner FCF (OCF - CapEx - IFRS16 lease principal), which is what ties to the company's reported figure; net debt excludes lease liabilities to avoid double-counting.
Non-GAAP gross margin 49.0% (FY26) differs from statutory gross margin 21.2% because statutory cost of sales includes assembly & distribution.
EPS reported in NZ DOLLARS (not cents, unlike many NZX filers); dividends quoted in cents.
LIVE strategic review announced 28-Apr-2026 (Cameron Partners advisor); no outcome as of 13-Aug-2026. ~17% deal premium already in the price.
